name: Suzy Says!
summary:
After an evening at a friend's house after school, you return home to find a mysterious new interactive DVD game waiting for you. Meet Suzy! A cheerful character who's just bursting with excitement to meet you! With her colourful interactive floor mat acting as a cool twist on Simon Says, what could possibly go wrong?

Listen carefully, follow the rules, and whatever you do, do not disappoint Suzy! After all, Suzy says you're going to be best friends forever!
